g.title: LCH_QSP
g.text: Langerhans Cell Histiocytosis (LCH) — Mechanistic QSP Map
Misrouted myeloid DC precursor × cell-of-origin partition × ERK-driven senescent secretome × cytostatic MAPK inhibition and rebound × irreversible sequelae as time-integrals

g.title: cluster_driver
g.text: 1. 체성 드라이버 변이 (Somatic MAPK Driver Lesions — ~85% of cases)

g.title: cluster_origin
g.text: 2. 기원세포 분화단계 (Cell-of-Origin Stage — the misguided-myeloid-DC model)

g.title: cluster_identity
g.text: 4. 병리적 LCH 세포 표현형 (Pathologic LCH Cell Identity)

g.title: cluster_micro
g.text: 5. 병변 미세환경 (Lesional Inflammatory Microenvironment — the granuloma)

g.title: cluster_secretome
g.text: 6. 사이토카인 · 케모카인 분비체 (ERK-Driven Secretome — the 'cytokine storm' of LCH)

g.title: cluster_bone
g.text: 7. 골 병변 · 골재형성 (Osteolytic Bone Lesion & Remodelling — 80% of patients)

g.title: cluster_pituitary
g.text: 8. 시상하부-뇌하수체 축 · 중추성 요붕증 (Hypothalamic-Pituitary Axis & Central DI — the commonest permanent sequela)

g.title: cluster_nd
g.text: 9. LCH 관련 신경변성 (LCH-Associated Neurodegeneration, LCH-ND — late, irreversible, therapy-refractory)

g.title: cluster_risk
g.text: 10. 위험장기 침범 (Risk-Organ Involvement — haematopoietic, liver, spleen)

g.title: cluster_lung
g.text: 11. 폐 LCH (Pulmonary LCH — smoking-driven in adults)

g.title: cluster_skin
g.text: 12. 피부 · 점막 · 기타 부위 (Skin, Mucosa & Other Sites)

g.title: cluster_class
g.text: 13. 임상 분류 · 위험 계층화 (Clinical Classification & Risk Stratification)

g.title: cluster_chemo
g.text: 16. 세포독성 · 면역조절 화학요법 PK/PD (Vinblastine · Prednisolone · Cytarabine · Cladribine · Clofarabine)

g.title: cluster_effect
g.text: 17. 약물 효과의 분기 (The Cytostatic / Cytotoxic Split — why response ≠ cure)
